speech: Greetings friend. I am a manufacturer of leather.
I see you have brought me a hide. Would you like me to tan it for you?
I see you have brought me some hides. Would you like me to tan them for you?
Yes please.
No thanks.
Very well, sir, as you wish.
Very well, madam, as you wish.
Can I buy some leather then?
I make leather from animal hides. Bring me some cowhides and one gold coin per hide, and I'll tan them into soft leather for you.
Leather is rather weak stuff.
Normal leather may be quite weak, but it's very cheap - I make it from cowhides for only 1 gp per hide - and it's so easy to craft that anyone can work with it.
Alternatively you could try hard leather. It's not so easy to craft, but I only charge 3 gp per cowhide to prepare it, and it makes much sturdier armour.
I can also tan snake hides and dragonhides, suitable for crafting into the highest quality armour for rangers.
Thanks, I'll bear it in mind.
Welcome to the Mining Guild. Can I help you with anything?
What have you got in the guild?
Ooh, it's WONDERFUL! There are lots of coal rocks, and even a few mithril rocks in the guild, all exclusively for people with atleast level 60 mining.
There's no better mining site anywhere near here.
It's a good thing I have level 60 Mining.
Yes, that's amazing! Did you want anything else?
So you won't let me go in there?
Sorry, but rules are rules. Go do some more training first. Can I help you with anything else?
No thanks, I'm fine.
Yeah...whada you want?
Who are you?
I'm nobody you need to worry about...who are you? Why are you asking so many questions? Are you with the Varrock guards?
What're you doing here?
Well, as if it's any of your business, I'm an associate of Hammerspike. He's a great dwarf you know. You could learn a lot from a dwarf like him.
Who do you work for?
I have an ongoing contract with Hammerspike, when he gives the word, the hammer starts flying.
Okay, thanks.
Hello, and welcome to the Crafting Guild. Accomplished crafters from all over the land come here to use our top notch workshops.
Yeah?
Hello.
Whassup?
So... are you here to give crafting tips?
Dude, do I look like I wanna talk to you?
I suppose not.
Right on!
Oi'm busy. If tha' wants owt, tha' can go find Wyson. He's ta boss 'round here. And KEEP YER TRAMPIN' FEET ORFF MA' FLOWERS!
Right...
Would you like to buy some archery equipment?
No thanks, I've got all the archery equipment I need.
Okay. Fare well on your travels.
Hello.
What are you doing here?
I'm just wandering around.
You do realise you're wandering around in my house?
Yep.
Well please get out!
Sheesh, keep your wig on!
I was hoping you'd give me some free stuff.
No, I jolly well wouldn't! Get out of my house!
Meanie!
Aaaarrgh!
Eeeek!
Hello sir. What are you doing in my house?
Oh dear, are you lost?
Yes, I'm lost.
Okay, just walk north-east when you leave this house, and soon you'll reach the big city of Falador.
Thanks a lot.
No, I know where I am.
Oh? Well, would you mind wandering somewhere else? This is my house.
Meh!
Do you REALLY need it?
Er...
I don't have much on me...
I don't know...
(beg beg beg beg beg beg)
I promise I'll stop bothering you!
Pleeease!
Pwetty pleathe wiv thugar on top!
Oh, alright. Here you go.
Eeeek!
Hello there.
Hello old bean. Is there something I can help you with?
My name is Tarquin Marjoribanks.
I'd be surprised if you haven't already heard of me?
Why would I have heard of you Mr. Marjoribanks?
It's pronounced 'Marchbanks'!
You should know of me because I am a member of the royal family of Misthalin!
Are you related to King Roald?
Oh yes! Quite closely actually.
I'm his 4th cousin, once removed on his mothers side.
Er... Okay. What are you doing here then?
I'm canoeing on the river! It's enormous fun! Would you like to know how?
Could you teach me about canoes?
Can you teach me about canoes?
No thanks, not right now.
Well, you don't look like you have the skill to make a canoe.
You need to have at least level 12 woodcutting.
Once you are able to make a canoe it makes travel along the river much quicker!
It's really quite simple. Just walk down to that tree on the bank and chop it down.
When you have done that you can shape the log further with your axe to make a canoe.
My personal favourite is the Stable Dugout canoe. A finer craft you'll never see old bean!
A Stable Dugout canoe will take you pretty much the length of the Lum river.
Of course there are other canoes.
Further up river, near the Barbarian Village, I saw some darned fool 'canoeing' on a log!
Unfortunately, you don't have the skill to create anything more than one of those logs. I dare say it will only get 1 stop down the river!
Still, I'm sure it will satisfy one such as yourself.
What's that supposed to mean?
Do not profane the royal house of Varrock by engaging me in further discourse you knave!
Pfft! I doubt he even knows the King!
You seem to be quite handy with an axe though!
I'm sure you can build a Dugout canoe. Not as fine as a Stable Dugout but it will carry you 2 stops on the river.
I should imagine it would suit your limited means.
What do you mean when you say 'limited means'?
Well, you're just an itinerant adventurer!
What possible reason would you have for cluttering up my river with your inferior water craft!
Ah! Perfect! You can make a Stable Dugout canoe! One of those will carry you to any civilised place on the river.
If you were of good pedigree I'd let you join my boat club. You seem to be one of those vagabond adventurers though.
Charming!
Be off with you rogue!
Well ... erm. You seem to be able to make a Waka!
Sounds fun, what's a Waka.
I've only ever seen one man on the river who uses a Waka. A big, fearsome looking fellow up near Edgeville.
People say he was born in the Wilderness and that he is looking for a route back.
Is that true!
How should I know? I would not consort with such a base fellow!
Hi cat!
Miaooow!
What?
Actually I've got no time for this. I don't want to talk to you.
